caseStudies.title: Fashion & Apparel Brand Scaling
caseStudies.description: Scaled sales with 6 scroll-stopping video creatives, built a fast 1-page checkout landing page, and integrated server-side CAPI tracking.
caseStudies.fullDetails: The client was struggling with high customer acquisition costs and rising Facebook ad fatigue on their traditional FB page. We audited their Ad Account, rebuilt their pixel tracking with Meta Conversions API (CAPI), scripted and produced 6 user-generated video ads targeting Dhaka and divisional shoppers, and engineered a fast mobile-first order form that allowed customers to order in under 20 seconds with Cash on Delivery (COD). Within 60 days, daily orders scaled from 15 to 80+ while maintaining a 4.2x blended ROAS.

caseStudies.title: B2B Service & SaaS Growth
caseStudies.description: Switched from broad keywords to high-intent Google Search ads paired with a 2-step qualification quiz that filters out spam clicks.
caseStudies.fullDetails: The company was wasting over 65% of their ad spend on broad Google Ads clicks from students and irrelevant searchers. We implemented exact-match negative keyword filtering, restructured campaigns around high-intent decision maker queries, and built a dynamic 2-step qualification quiz that filtered out non-budget prospects before booking. Lead quality increased by 160% while reducing Cost-Per-Acquisition (CPA) by 60%.

caseStudies.title: Fitness & Wellness Mobile App
caseStudies.description: Produced 12 user-generated TikTok/Reels ads and leveraged deep app-linking on Google App Campaigns to maximize paid trial activations.
caseStudies.fullDetails: To scale app installs across Southeast Asia and Bangladesh, we tested 12 vertical hook-driven short videos on Meta Reels and YouTube Shorts. We utilized deep app-linking directly to Google Play and Apple App Store, reducing install drop-off. The campaign generated over 25,000 installs at an average $2.10 Cost Per Install (CPI) with high 7-day retention.
deliverables: Meta Reels & YouTube Shorts Video Production
